Forwards all five arguments to the local checkbox-capable password helper and returns its Boolean. It performs no login lookup or persistence.

Boolean consumed by Calendar discovery; checked value requests later saving but this method itself does not persist.

## Errors

Helper exceptions propagate.

## Async completion

Synchronous modal helper call, no Promise.
